title: Kennedy Causeway Bridge Operational Milestone — Phase 65 Florida Space Coast authority and mission delivery review
summary: Phase 65 reviews this primary record as part of the Florida Space Coast authority and mission delivery reporting pack. NASA records the Kennedy Causeway Bridge as fully operational after the westbound span opened on March 18, 2025, replacing the former two-lane drawbridge.
key_findings: The bridge is the primary access connection for Kennedy and Cape Canaveral employees and visitors.
NASA records both bridge directions as operational after the westbound opening.
A $90 million federal infrastructure grant funded nearly half of the bridge replacement and nearby road widening.
why_it_matters: Which records connect licences, operators, infrastructure capital, construction, accepted facilities, mission use, safety, and repeat operations? This record supplies one bounded part of that evidence chain; it is not a substitute for the pack's downstream records. It supplies a rare completed-and-operational infrastructure record for the corridor.
ftfn_relevance: Closes construction and opening stages for a named access asset.
Links federal, NASA, and Florida capital to an operating facility.
Creates later checks for traffic, reliability, logistics, and mission-support outcomes.
evidence_limits: Inclusion in a Phase 65 reporting pack does not advance a Phase 64 matrix cell or establish an operating outcome.
The record does not provide traffic, reliability, cost, or logistics performance.
It does not prove a causal change in launch capacity or mission outcomes.
